note: USACE campground on the western shore of Rend Lake by the Sandusky cove, on two wooded peninsulas; the Rend Lake Bike Trail passes through. Only a few sites are truly lakefront: WO047 sits about 30 m from a cove over open grass and PI010 about 30 m from the shore past scattered trees; most others are 40 m or more back behind trees. --Claude
summary: rec.gov facility, rates, catalog and calendar read; imagery + 3DEP. 97 sites (96 reservable), all 50 A, water at 29, sewer at 21, back-in to 90 ft; 2027 fees $20/$24/$28 (stored 18-22 missed full hookup); season 03-26..10-31. Lakefront kept with a caveat naming WO047 and PI010. Pin moves ~500 m to the campground.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront kept, narrowly, with a caveat in the note. rec.gov lists 'Waterfront Sites' (no per-site waterfront attribute). Imagery: WO047 (38.06670,-89.00222) ~30 m from the south cove over open grass (3DEP 418.9 ft vs water 408.2 ft); PI010 (38.06547,-89.00020) ~25-35 m from the shore past scattered trees with an open strip at the water (415.7 vs 409.6 ft). Borderline: WO046 ~45 m behind the shore road and a tree clump; PI011/PI012 40-60 m with a tree clump; HI101 (38.06555,-89.00670) ~35 m behind a partial screen. Treed: WO110-112, HI102 (44-63 m). If a reviewer reads PI010's scattered trees as a screen, this is lakeview with one lakefront site.

PIN: stored 38.0711111,-89.0055556 (rec.gov facility point) is ~495 m north-west of the sites, across a cove. Move to 38.0668,-89.0041 (all-site centroid, between the two peninsulas) or 38.06706,-89.00077 (east peninsula, 55 sites).
